cohort: A single patient who underwent a cesarean section with lower uterine segment compression suture due to placenta previa totalis.
finding: A uterovesical fistula developed in a patient after a lower uterine segment compression suture was applied during a cesarean section for placenta previa totalis.
mod_finding: A uterovesical fistula developed after a lower uterine segment compression suture performed during a cesarean section.
